# BuildIsolatedSite

## Purpose, entry points and ownership

- Own the final BenchmarkComparisons website build composite action; entry point: action.yml.
- Read the root AGENTS.md, workflows/AGENTS.md, docs/Architecture.md, BenchmarkComparisons feature acceptance/execution contracts and ADR-056 before changes.
- Run from the actual qualified website checkout after all native site/analyzer TUnit, coverage and no-skip gates pass. Keep website, current measured and workflow-control revisions accurate and independent.
- Owner-directed ADR-076 retires the obsolete twelve-file archive, three-profile builder dependency and their active schema fields together. The complete current cohort is the sole live authority; preserve raw-byte comparisons, actual qualification-job lookup and schema-v2 source/test/coverage/original isolated receipt fields.
- Verify both original isolated archives and all277 input hashes before and after the bounded standalone builder, retain the exact aggregate manifest and preserve the bounded original archive receipt under publication.isolated.
- Preserve least privilege and the actual inherited GitHub context. Never log secrets, forge a CI environment, add a provider fallback, weaken gates or rewrite measured inputs.
- Require the isolated receipt to be a regular non-link file of at most4MiB before parsing; preserve original receipt bytes and hashes across the builder. Do not use generic archive extraction or replace original authority with a rewritten receipt.

## Boundaries and protected risks

Follow the [root policy](../../../../../AGENTS.md) and the owning feature specification. Keep changes in their actual owner, preserve unrelated work, and remove replaced code together with exclusive callers and fixtures. Use native Orleans calls for distributed execution and silo-local ZoneTree owners for files. Preserve persisted authorization, operation correctness, resource bounds, cancellation and joined shutdown. Never turn a static check or focused test into a claim of complete runtime qualification.

## Commands and verification

From the repository root:

```sh
dotnet build KeyLoad.slnx --no-restore -warnaserror
```

Use the root's complete solution, native TUnit, real process recovery and Aspire SDK/MCP gates as applicable. Local checks are development evidence; delivered-source qualification and public measurements require exact-source Linux GitHub artifacts. Do not weaken compiler, analyzer, source-identity, coverage or runtime assertions.

## Skills

Use the installed Orleans skill for Orleans design and the relevant installed formatting, Aspire or diagnostics skill when the task needs it. Follow explicit owner scope and dependency-adoption rules.
